LanguageData.Namae_NamesEnableDesc: Replace generated pawn names (first, last, nickname) using the loaded language pack.
LanguageData.Namae_AnimalNamesEnableDesc: Use ordinary katakana pet names instead of localized concept words or untranslated English names. Numeric animal labels and names entered by the player are unchanged.
LanguageData.Namae_AutoNameColonyAnimals: Give colony animals proper names immediately
LanguageData.Namae_AutoNameColonyAnimalsDesc: Replace a colony animal's numeric label with a proper name when it is born, hatched, tamed, self-tamed, or joins the colony. Existing proper names and player-entered names are unchanged.
LanguageData.Namae_AvoidDuplicateAnimalNames: Avoid duplicate names within the same animal species
LanguageData.Namae_AvoidDuplicateAnimalNamesDesc: Choose a name not currently used by another colony animal of the same species. If every available name is already in use, duplicates are allowed.
LanguageData.Namae_RetranslateConfirm:
Rename every existing pawn in the loaded save using the name dictionary.

- This cannot be undone. Back up your save first.
- Names with no dictionary entry are left as they are.
- Only pawn names are changed.
LanguageData.Namae_PlayingOnly: (Renaming existing pawns is only available while a save is loaded.)
LanguageData.Namae_PseudoTranslationEnableDesc: Keep untranslated English text readable instead of replacing its letters with accented pseudo-translation characters. This has no effect outside developer mode.
LanguageData.Namae_PseudoTranslationCheckDesc: Check: If the sentence below is readable, the setting is working.
LanguageData.Namae_DevTooltipsEnable: Show descriptions in the developer menu
LanguageData.Namae_DevTooltipsEnableDesc: Show what a developer action does when the pointer is over it. Truncated labels are also shown in full.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionDesc_UseScatterer: Test what the selected Scatterer places without regenerating the whole map. Depending on the scatterer, it may add buildings, rocks, plants, or other objects.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionDesc_BaseGen: Build rooms, walls, and other structures from the selected BaseGen symbol. The generated structures remain on the current map.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionDesc_SketchGen: Create a building-layout sketch from its generation rules, then place that result on the current map. The result remains on the map.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionDesc_StorywatcherTick1Day: Update StoryWatcher records by one day. This does not advance the whole game by one day.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionDesc_LeakMap: Keep a map reference after disposal to reproduce a map remaining in memory. Intended only for memory-leak investigation.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionDesc_PrintLeakedMap: Write identifying information for the retained map to Player.log. Run the map-retention action first.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionHelp_Toggle: Each click toggles this display or diagnostic feature on or off.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionHelp_Submenu: Click to open a list of choices. No action is performed yet.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionHelp_SelectPawn: After clicking, select a pawn on the map to perform the action.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionHelp_SelectMap: After clicking, select a map cell or target to perform the action.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionHelp_SelectWorld: After clicking, select a location or target on the world map to perform the action.
LanguageData.Namae_DevActionHelp_Immediate: Clicking performs the action immediately. Some actions do not ask for confirmation.
LanguageData.Namae_DevLabelsEnableDesc: Replace labels for developer actions that have a translation. Unsupported and mod-added actions keep their original labels.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSetting_DebugViewSettings_write: Write List Filth In Home Area
LanguageData.Namae_DevOutput_DynamicDrawnThingsByCate: Dynamic Drawn Things By Category Now
LanguageData.Namae_DevOutput_AnimalPointsToHuntOrSlau: Animal Points To Hunt Or Slaughter
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_enabl: Allows damage to be applied during normal game processing. Turn it off to test situations without pawns and things taking damage.
Allows damage to affect player-controlled pawns and things. Turn it off to protect the player side while other factions can still take damage.
Allows the storyteller and other normal systems to start random mental states. Turn it off to prevent random mental breaks during a test.
Allows the storyteller to generate incidents normally. Turn it off to keep raids and other storyteller incidents from interrupting a test.
Allows diseases generated by normal random incidents. Turn it off to stop new random diseases while testing.
Shows the translation debugging window in English even when another language is active. This helps compare translation keys and source text.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_godMo: Enables instant construction and other god-mode controls. Actions performed with it can change the current map and save data immediately.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_devPa: Enables the developer palette used to inspect and choose debug colors. It affects developer tools rather than ordinary gameplay.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_pause: Pauses the game when an error is logged. Use it to stop at the moment a reproducible error occurs and inspect the log.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_noAni: Prevents animals from being generated by normal game systems. Existing animals are not removed.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_unlim: Keeps powered devices supplied without relying on normal power generation. Use it to test buildings while ignoring the state of the power network.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_pathT: Lets pathfinding consider routes through normally impassable walls. It is a pathfinding test option and does not remove the walls.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_insta: Makes eligible recruitment attempts succeed immediately. It changes the recruited pawn and therefore affects the current save.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_alway: Forces eligible negative social interactions to become social fights. Use it to reproduce fight-related behavior and injuries.
Makes partnered pawns choose lovin whenever its normal eligibility checks allow it. It does not create a relationship or bypass every prerequisite.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_detec: Runs extra consistency checks for RegionLister contents and reports mismatches to the log. The additional checks can reduce performance.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_insta: Makes a visiting group deliver its departure gift without waiting for the normal timing. It changes the items received by the colony.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_lowFP: Artificially lowers the frame rate to reproduce behavior under slow rendering. It is intended for UI and timing tests, not normal play.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_allow: Allows direct orders to player-controlled mechs without drafting them first. It changes the command restriction, not mech ownership or control range.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_edita: Enables developer controls for editing the colors of light-emitting things. Changes made with those controls can alter the current object or definition being tested.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_showH: Includes pawns normally hidden from ordinary lists and selection views. It only changes developer visibility and does not unhide them for normal gameplay.
Reveals information that normal game UI intentionally hides, such as debug-only state. It changes what developers can inspect, not the underlying game state.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_anoma: Controls the screen-darkening effect used by Anomaly events. Turn it off to inspect maps without the visual darkening; the event itself continues.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_fastR: Greatly increases research progress so projects finish quickly. Completed research remains completed in the current save.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_fastL: Greatly accelerates pawn learning and training progress. Skill and learning changes produced while enabled remain in the save.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_fastE: Accelerates ecological updates such as plant and animal population changes. Use it to observe long-term ecology in a short test.
Accelerates only ecological regrowth while leaving other ecology timing unchanged. Use it to isolate plant and resource recovery behavior.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_fastC: Greatly accelerates work on crafting bills. Items completed while enabled are real items and remain in the save.
Greatly increases caravan travel speed on the world map. Distance traveled while enabled is not undone when the setting is turned off.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_fastM: Accelerates pollution removal across the map. Pollution already removed remains removed in the current save.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_activ: Treats all ideology building requirements as active for testing. It exposes requirements without changing the colony ideology itself.
Makes all ideology roles available for testing regardless of normal activation conditions. Assigning a role still changes the pawn and save.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_showL: Displays each pawn locomotion urgency for movement debugging. It adds diagnostic information without changing movement decisions.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_playR: Allows ritual ambience and background audio to play. Turn it off to test ritual visuals or logic without the ambience track.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_simul: Makes the game use Steam Deck-specific UI and input decisions for testing. It does not change the actual hardware or controller connection.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_logRa: Writes detailed raid generation and execution information to the log. Enable it only while diagnosing raids because it can produce many messages.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_logTr: Logs failed translation-key lookups and related translation problems. Use it to find missing or malformed keyed translations.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_logPs: Logs state transitions inside psychic rituals. Use it to trace where a ritual advances, waits, or fails.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_fastM: Shortens the wait before the monolith can return or respawn. A monolith spawned while enabled remains in the save.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_searc: Makes supported developer searches include entries normally excluded by restrictions. It broadens search results without changing the underlying definitions.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_alway: Forces successful fishing to choose from rare catches when possible. The caught item is added normally and remains in the save.
Forces successful fishing to choose negative catches when possible. Any resulting item or effect is applied normally.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_logMi: Logs generated layouts whose faction does not match the expected faction. Use it to diagnose base and structure generation.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_loopG: Repeats the gravship cutscene instead of letting it finish once. Use it to inspect timing, camera, and visual effects.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_skipG: Skips the normal destination-tile selection step for gravship travel. Use it to test later travel stages without repeating selection.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugSettings_ignor: Allows gravship destinations beyond the normal travel range to be selected. It bypasses the range check but does not add fuel or change the ship.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugViewSettings_d: Shows or hides the fog-of-war layer. This is useful for inspecting unrevealed map areas and does not reveal them in the save.
Shows or hides snow graphics on map cells. Snow depth and movement effects remain unchanged.
Shows or hides sand-depth graphics. The stored sand depth and its gameplay effects are not changed.
Shows or hides the map terrain layer. Use it to isolate buildings, pawns, and overlays from the ground graphics.
Shows or hides water-specific terrain rendering while leaving water terrain data intact.
Shows or hides Things rendered dynamically each frame, such as moving or frequently changing objects. Their simulation continues when hidden.
Shows or hides Things cached into map-section meshes. Use it to distinguish cached rendering from dynamic rendering.
Shows or hides object shadows. Lighting levels and gameplay visibility calculations are not changed.
Shows or hides the map lighting overlay. Use it to inspect unlit graphics separately from the lighting pass.
Shows or hides informational overlays on the world map. World objects and their state remain active.
Shows or hides gas clouds on the map. Gas quantities, spread, and effects continue while hidden.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugViewSettings_s: Forces supported drawing work onto one thread. Use it to reproduce rendering-order and thread-safety problems; performance may decrease.
LanguageData.Namae_DevSettingDesc_DebugViewSettings_d: Shows or hides world objects such as settlements and sites. Their simulation and world-map data continue while hidden.
Draws current pawn paths on the map. It exposes selected route cells without changing pathfinding decisions.
Displays internal Pather state for moving pawns, including progress and current path status. It is diagnostic only.
Draws candidate cells and results considered when searching for a ranged attack position. It visualizes the search without choosing a different position.
Draws cells examined while searching for a movement destination. Use it to see why a destination was accepted or rejected.
Draws the candidates evaluated when selecting a visual style. It reports the search process without changing the selected style.
Outlines map-section boundaries used by cached rendering. Use it to locate section seams and rebuild problems.
Displays river-generation diagnostic geometry on the world map. It does not regenerate or move existing rivers.
Displays river-flow directions and related flow data. It is a diagnostic overlay and does not change water movement.
Adds general AI and state diagnostics around pawns. It can clutter the map but does not issue jobs or alter pawn state.
Draws the direction each pawn rotator is trying to face. Use it to diagnose facing and rotation interpolation.
Colors the pathfinding Regions on the map. It shows the current Region partition without rebuilding it.
Draws links between neighboring Regions. Use it to find missing or incorrect pathfinding connections.
Highlights Regions marked dirty and waiting for rebuild. It does not force the rebuild itself.
Visualizes Regions visited by supported traversal searches. It helps trace search order without changing the result.
Displays Things registered in each Region. Use it to diagnose stale or missing RegionLister entries.
Colors pathfinding Districts, which group connected Regions through doors. It is a diagnostic view only.
Colors Rooms derived from the current Region and District structure. It does not recalculate room roles or statistics.
Displays power-related diagnostics on connected buildings and networks. It does not supply or consume power.
Draws cells and links belonging to each power network. Use it to find unexpected connections or disconnections.
Displays opportunistic Jobs considered around a pawn current work. It does not assign those Jobs.
Outlines tooltip regions registered by the UI. Use it to diagnose overlap, clipping, and incorrect hover areas.
Displays noise events recorded for AI hearing and reaction systems. It does not create new noise.
Runs the supported food search from the cell under the mouse and draws the candidates and result. It is a diagnostic query and does not order a pawn to eat.
Displays hunting and prey-selection information around animals. It shows evaluation data without assigning a hunt target.
Displays the map glow grid and light levels. It reveals calculated lighting data without adding light sources.
Displays the avoid grid used to discourage pawn movement through hazardous or undesirable cells. It does not modify path costs.
Displays BreachingGrid values used when attackers choose walls and breach routes. It does not start a breach or change the grid.
Displays noise values that influence breach-path selection. It does not create sound or alert pawns.
Displays active Lords and the pawn groups they coordinate. It is a diagnostic overlay and does not change group AI.
Displays each pawn current Duty assigned by its Lord. It does not assign or replace Duties.
Displays shooting geometry such as lines, targets, and calculated positions. It does not fire a weapon or alter hit chances.
Colors cells by their current insect-infestation chance. It does not trigger an infestation or change the calculated chance.
Colors cells by their suitability or chance for a fleshmass heart. It does not generate the heart.
Displays item choices and scores used by stealing AI. It does not order a pawn to steal or move items.
Displays underground resource deposits detected by the map data. It does not reveal them through normal gameplay or mine them.
Displays candidate attack targets and the scores used to rank them. It does not force a different target.
Displays symmetry checks used by field-of-view calculations. Use it to find directional inconsistencies without changing visibility.
Displays the timer used to classify or handle non-combatants. It does not change faction or combat status.
Marks interaction cells used when pawns operate buildings and objects. It does not reserve or occupy those cells.
Displays door state, access, and opening diagnostics. It does not open, close, or unlock doors.
Displays destination-cell reservations held by pawns. It does not create or release reservations.
Draws rectangles and areas used by supported damage calculations. It does not apply damage.
Draw Dissolution Cells. This overlay helps inspect the corresponding map or UI state and does not modify the underlying data.
Draw Unpollution Cells. This overlay helps inspect the corresponding map or UI state and does not modify the underlying data.
